WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "valid_from" AS "VALID_FROM",
      "valid_to" AS "VALID_TO"
    FROM "shop"."memberships"
  ),
  "menura_2_days" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "VALID_FROM",
      "VALID_TO",
      "VALID_FROM" AS "menura.from_day",
      "VALID_TO" AS "menura.to_day",
      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY "CUSTOMER_ID", "VALID_FROM", "VALID_TO") AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
  ),
  "menura_3_overlaps" AS (
    SELECT
      "menura_row"."menura.row" AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_2_days" AS "menura_row"
    JOIN "menura_2_days" AS "menura_other" ON "menura_row"."menura.row" <> "menura_other"."menura.row" AND "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL AND "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "menura_other"."CUSTOMER_ID" AND "menura_row"."menura.from_day" IS NOT NULL AND ("menura_row"."menura.to_day" IS NULL OR "menura_row"."menura.from_day" <= "menura_row"."menura.to_day") AND "menura_other"."menura.from_day" IS NOT NULL AND ("menura_other"."menura.to_day" IS NULL OR "menura_other"."menura.from_day" <= "menura_other"."menura.to_day") AND ("menura_other"."menura.to_day" IS NULL OR "menura_row"."menura.from_day" <= "menura_other"."menura.to_day") AND ("menura_row"."menura.to_day" IS NULL OR "menura_other"."menura.from_day" <= "menura_row"."menura.to_day")
    GROUP BY 1
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "VALID_FROM" AS "VALID_FROM",
  "VALID_TO" AS "VALID_TO",
  'invalid_interval' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_days"
WHERE "menura.from_day" IS NOT NULL AND "menura.to_day" IS NOT NULL AND "menura.from_day" > "menura.to_day"
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "VALID_FROM" AS "VALID_FROM",
  "VALID_TO" AS "VALID_TO",
  'overlap' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_days"
WHERE "menura.row" IN (SELECT "menura.row" FROM "menura_3_overlaps")

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "period_at" AS "PERIOD_AT"
    FROM "shop"."roster"
  ),
  "menura_2_periods" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "PERIOD_AT",
      CAST(date_trunc('month', "PERIOD_AT") AS DATE) AS "menura.period"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "menura.period" AS "PERIOD_AT",
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS "row_count"
FROM "menura_2_periods"
WHERE "CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL AND "PERIOD_AT" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY "CUSTOMER_ID", "VALID_FROM", "VALID_TO") AS "menura.row"

    GROUP BY 1
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",

SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "VALID_FROM" AS "VALID_FROM",
  "VALID_TO" AS "VALID_TO",
  'overlap' AS "violation"

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "period" AS "PERIOD"
    FROM "shop"."balances"
  ),
  "menura_2_snapshots" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      CAST(date_trunc('month', "PERIOD") AS DATE) AS "menura.period"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL AND "PERIOD" IS NOT NULL
  ),
  "menura_3_seen" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "menura.period" AS "menura.period"
    FROM "menura_2_snapshots"
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ),
  "menura_4_bounds" AS (
    SELECT
      MIN("menura.period") AS "menura.first",
      MAX("menura.period") AS "menura.last"
    FROM "menura_2_snapshots"
  ),
  "menura_5_starts" AS (
    SELECT
      unnest(generate_series(CAST("menura.first" AS TIMESTAMP), CAST("menura.last" AS TIMESTAMP), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS "menura.start"
    FROM "menura_4_bounds"
  ),
  "menura_6_series" AS (
    SELECT
      CAST("menura.start" AS DATE) AS "menura.period"
    FROM "menura_5_starts"
  ),
  "menura_7_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "period_at" AS "PERIOD_AT"
    FROM "shop"."roster"
  ),
  "menura_8_expected" AS (
    SELECT
      "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "menura_period"."menura.period" AS "menura.period"
    FROM "menura_7_scan" AS "menura_row"
    JOIN "menura_6_series" AS "menura_period" ON CAST(date_trunc('month', "menura_row"."PERIOD_AT") AS DATE) = "menura_period"."menura.period"
    WHERE "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "menura.period" AS "PERIOD",
  'duplicate_snapshot' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_snapshots"
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "menura.period" AS "PERIOD",
  'gap' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_6_series"
WHERE "menura.period" NOT IN (SELECT "menura.period" FROM "menura_3_seen")
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "menura_expected"."CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "menura_expected"."menura.period" AS "PERIOD",
  'missing_entity' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_8_expected" AS "menura_expected"
LEFT JOIN "menura_3_seen" AS "menura_seen" ON "menura_expected"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "menura_seen"."CUSTOMER_ID" AND "menura_expected"."menura.period" = "menura_seen"."menura.period"
WHERE "menura_seen"."menura.period" IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "menura_seen"."CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "menura_seen"."menura.period" AS "PERIOD",
  'unexpected_entity' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_3_seen" AS "menura_seen"
LEFT JOIN "menura_8_expected" AS "menura_expected" ON "menura_seen"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "menura_expected"."CUSTOMER_ID" AND "menura_seen"."menura.period" = "menura_expected"."menura.period"
WHERE "menura_expected"."menura.period" IS NULL

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "snapshot" AS "SNAPSHOT"
    FROM "shop"."balances"
  ),
  "menura_2_snapshots" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "SNAPSHOT" AS "menura.period"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL AND "SNAPSHOT" IS NOT NULL
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "menura.period" AS "SNAPSHOT",
  'duplicate_snapshot' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_snapshots"
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
